name: university-event-management-system
description: University Event Management System - Express/Prisma API + React UI in one repo

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend run migrate:deploy && npm --prefix backend run seed:startup && npm --prefix backend start
